item.title: “The MA-37 is the guitar player’s secret weapon.” - Tim Pierce
item.description:
“The MA-37 is the guitar player’s secret weapon.” - Tim Pierce

World-renowned Los Angeles-based guitarist Tim Pierce has played on over 1,000 hit records with artists like Elton John, Madonna, Bruce Springsteen, Seal, Celine Dion and Michael Jackson.

Today, his popular YouTube channel @TimPierceGuitar offers masterclasses, gear reviews, and industry insights.

Thank you Tim!

item.title: Recently I have been playing with this 9-string Soprano/Charango guitar to change things up. The guitar is tuned an octave above standard tuning with ...
item.description:
Recently I have been playing with this 9-string Soprano/Charango guitar to change things up. The guitar is tuned an octave above standard tuning with the top three strings doubled and the bottom three strings single. The contrabass guitar is tuned an octave below standard tuning. These guitars are made by Frank Rodriguez who is based in Houston, Texas.
